name: SlideVerse – The Ultimate Slider Block for Gutenberg
author: WPXERO

sections.description:
SlideVerse is a powerful Gutenberg slider block plugin that seamlessly integrates the flexibility of Swiper.js, the most advanced mobile-friendly slider library, into WordPress. With SlideVerse, you can create stunning, fully responsive sliders for images, videos, and custom content directly inside the Gutenberg block editor—no coding required!

Whether you’re a blogger, designer, marketer, or business owner, SlideVerse helps you build interactive, high-performance sliders that enhance your website’s visual appeal, user engagement, and UX/UI design.

Why Choose SlideVerse?

  • 🚀 Gutenberg-Optimized Slider Block – Easily create professional sliders using a dedicated SlideVerse Slider Block inside WordPress’s native block editor.
  • 🔄 Infinite Scrolling Slider – Introduced in version 0.0.2, this feature lets you build smooth, auto-looping sliders for dynamic content presentation.
  • 📱 Fully Responsive & Touch-Enabled – Optimized for mobile-friendly, touch, swipe, and drag interactions on all devices.
  • 🎨 Advanced Customization – Control autoplay, loop mode, pagination, navigation, speed, and transition effects with ease.
  • 🏗 Multi-Content Support – Add any Gutenberg blocks (images, text, buttons, videos, and even third-party blocks) to your sliders.
  • ⚡ Lightweight & Performance-Optimized – Fast-loading slider ensures smooth performance without slowing down your website.
  • ✨ Stylish & Modern Design – Customize spacing, alignment, colors, and typography to match your brand and site aesthetics.

Perfect for:

✅ Bloggers & Content Creators
✅ eCommerce Stores (Product Sliders)
✅ Agencies & Designers
✅ Business Websites
✅ Photographers & Portfolio Showcases

With SlideVerse, crafting eye-catching, SEO-friendly sliders in WordPress has never been easier. Elevate your website’s engagement and user experience today! 🚀

Credits

  • Swiper js: Built on the advanced Swiper.js library. Learn more at Swiper.js.

Support

For questions, issues, or feedback, please visit the GitHub Repository or create a support ticket in the WordPress plugin directory.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and Install:
    • Upload the slideverse folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
    • Alternatively, search for SlideVerse in the WordPress plugin repository and install it directly through the admin panel.
  2. Activate:
    • Go to the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress and activate SlideVerse.
  3. Start Creating Sliders:
    • Open the Gutenberg editor, insert the SlideVerse Slider block, and begin building your sliders with your preferred content.
sections.faq:
What is SlideVerse?

SlideVerse is a WordPress plugin designed to create modern, responsive sliders using Swiper.js within the Gutenberg editor. It allows for seamless integration of various content types into sliders.

What is the Infinite Slider Block?

The Infinite Slider Block, introduced in version 0.0.2, allows you to create sliders with infinite scrolling, making it perfect for dynamic and engaging presentations.

Can I use other blocks inside SlideVerse sliders?

Yes! SlideVerse supports all core and third-party Gutenberg blocks, letting you integrate images, text, videos, or custom blocks into your sliders.

Does SlideVerse support mobile devices?

Absolutely. SlideVerse leverages Swiper.js, optimized for touch gestures and swipe navigation, ensuring a seamless user experience on all devices.

How customizable are the sliders?

SlideVerse offers a wide range of customization options, including autoplay, loop mode, pagination, and navigation settings—all accessible directly in the block settings panel.

Does SlideVerse impact website performance?

No, SlideVerse is lightweight and optimized for fast loading, ensuring your sliders look great without slowing down your website.

0.0.4 – February 17, 2025

  • Enhancement: General performance enhancements and code optimizations for a smoother user experience.

  • New Feature: Introduced the Before After Slider block, allowing users to compare two images interactively with a draggable handle.
  • Enhancement: Improved performance and optimized loading times for slider blocks.
  • Fix: Resolved minor styling issues in the Infinite Slider block.

0.0.2 – January 27, 2025

  • New Feature: Added the Infinite Slider block for creating dynamic, seamless scrolling sliders.
  • Improved performance and stability for all slider types.
  • Minor bug fixes and code optimizations.

0.0.1 – January 01, 2025

  • Initial Release: First official release of SlideVerse.
  • Introduced Swiper.js-powered slider functionality.
  • Added the SlideVerse Slider block for Gutenberg.
  • Enabled support for touch and swipe gestures.
  • Included customization options for autoplay, navigation, and pagination.
